text: In September 2017 we returned, almost all of us, to one phrase. Ninety-nine of us said "deferred action for childhood," peaking on 2017-09-05; ninety-eight said "deferred action for childhood arrivals" the same day. First spoken on 2013-02-13 by Chuck Grassley, it was four years old by the time we converged on it together. Ninety of us said "childhood arrivals daca," eighty-four "deferred action for childhood arrivals daca," and eighty-four "the deferred action." Eighty said "the deferred action for childhood," seventy-nine "the deferred action for childhood arrivals," and seventy-nine "childhood arrivals daca program." Every one of our most-repeated phrases named the same program, and every one peaked on the same day, 2017-09-05. We record that we arrived at the language separately over years and then, on one day, said it in near-unison.
